fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Carousel auto-rotates; recommended: 6 to 12 cards. Timeline: 6 to 10 cards. Pillars: up to 6 cards, JPG or PNG images only. Roller: 3 to 6 cards, one per scroll step. Rail: a horizontally scrolling row of fixed-width cards, any number. Features: cards that open their detail in place, with a next button (tech, safety or performance features).

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Pillars: 1. Label 2. Heading 3. Description, opening words in bold. Timeline: 1. Title as a heading, 2. Description 3. Location in italics. Roller: 1. Title as a heading 2. Description. Features: 1. Title as a heading (or in bold for a stat tile, e.g. 590 Nm) 2. Short line 3. and on: the detail, shown with the image when the card is opened (a heading first is the detail title).
